levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: «أبي» with no name is the compiler's father: relation; the text writes «سعد بنعبد الله» without a space, surface kept as written
«آبائه» is a collective kinship with no name: relation
the blessings after the names are not part of the surface; the Prophet is the end of the chain
